# subscribe to the release notes

Follow the releases of everything the dotfiles install — "check Brewfile and go toolset" — so that version bumps are driven by upstream release notes rather than by noticing breakage. In 2021 that meant watching the GitHub repositories of the Go tools and the formulae by hand.
